newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse Electric Corp Q3 loss smaller.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse Electric Corp Q3 loss smaller.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1995 nine months net profit and shr loss reflects payment of preferred dividends.
1996 Q3 includes a $30 million after-tax extraordinary loss from a non-cash write-off of deferred financing fees for the early extinguishment of debt.
1996 Q3 and nine months reflects a gain on the sale of the defense electronics business, partially offset by special charges, which favorably affected the results by $161 million.
1995 Q3 net income includes loss on discontinued operations of $79 million, or $0.04 per share.
1995 Q3 includes $146 million estimated loss on disposal of environmental services business.
1995 Q3 includes $1.16 billion gain on disposal of the defense and electronic systems business and Knoll.
